## Instructions 

Tick one box per row in § Rubric. Provide short and actionable feedback in § Feedback.
:::

## Rubric

::: {.rubric tbl-colwidths="[20,46,10,8,16]"}
| Criteria | Expectations | Exceeds | Meets | Developing |
|:--|:--|:--:|:--:|:--:|
| **Problem statement** | Restates the task in own words, lists data/givens, unknowns, and conditions/constraints, and clarifies any assumptions. | $\square$ | $\square$ | $\square$ |
| **Heuristics** | Selects at least one heuristic and explains/justifies why it is suitable. | $\square$ | $\square$ | $\square$ |
| **Plan quality** | Contains ordered steps and clearly defines any notation needed to proceed. | $\square$ | $\square$ | $\square$ |
| **Plan execution** | Executes steps that are technically correct and monitored (checked). | $\square$ | $\square$ | $\square$ |
| **Representations** | Chooses helpful representations (diagrams, tables, equations) and links them to the narrative. | $\square$ | $\square$ | $\square$ |
| **Reflection** | Verifies result (units/bounds/special cases) and notes generalizations or limitations. | $\square$ | $\square$ | $\square$ |
:::
